claims.text: All pts who smoke: pharmacotx (varenicline first-line; bupropion or NRT as alts) + behavioral counseling @ every visit.
claims.quote: All patients who smoke should receive pharmacotherapy (varenicline tartrate first-line; bupropion hydrochloride or nicotine replacement therapy as alternatives) combined with behavioral counseling at every visit.

claims.text: Smoke cessation = the single most effective intervention to slow FEV1 decline and ↓ COPD mortality.
claims.quote: Smoking cessation: The single most effective intervention to slow FEV1 decline and reduce COPD mortality.
